definition: A quick field cue that tells a style from its nearest neighbours: the 'if you see this and that together, it is this style' test, such as Tidewater Georgian's tall gable-end chimneys standing well clear of the roof.
basis: schema/style-node.schema.json, diagnostic tells: "Fast field-identification cues that distinguish it from its nearest siblings. The 'if you see X and Y together, it is this' set." styles/tidewater-georgian.json lists among its tells "Tall gable-end chimneys standing well clear of the roof".
